name: doctrine-runtime
description: The doctrine skills' runtime: the hooks (seat panes, the gate launcher, the restore after /clear, the context gauge, auto-cycle, the round and write guards, the doctrine band) and the dctr command the skills call. Installed with the doctrine skills plugin, which depends on it.

band.title: Doctrine band
band.description: One line above the prompt showing a live doctrine phase's state, round, alarm count, seats out and what is owed. Off draws nothing.
